liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Lazy Lightnin Tease (Supplication Jam)** (2 reviews): Jerry seems to try about ten times to start Lazy Lightning while Bobby and others ignore him; Jerry seems to push hard to launch Lazy Lightnin but gets shot down [35][37]
- **Crazy Fingers** (1 review): Reviewer ranks it among the finest Crazy Fingers of the 1980s [33]
- **High Time** (1 review): Described as a spine-tingling High Time [33]
- **Feel Like A Stranger** (1 review): Named by the reviewer as a highlight of the show [34]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): Named by the reviewer as a highlight, with plenty of energy [34]
- **It's All Over Now, Bbay Blue** (1 review): Reviewer considers this a quite nice version, made sadder by the cut in the tapes [30]

## Setlist highlights

- **stop hanging off the balcony**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [40]
- **my dog has no nose**: back after 1059 archived shows (5499 days); rare: 3 archived performances [40]
- **encore call**: back after 311 archived shows (1566 days); rare: 13 archived performances [40]

## The recordings

- **gd1985-06-27.sbd.gmb.79382.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 25 songs; 157 min; rated 4.5/5 by 8 [1]. Said about its sound: Uploader says it has less hiss and better stereo imaging than other good circulating sources [1]
- **gd1985-06-27.sbd.gmb.79558.flac24**: soundboard; 25 songs; 157 min [2]. Said about its sound: Uploader says it has less hiss than other good circulating sources, and its lineage omits a VHS tape [2]
- **gd1985-06-27.152627.akgc422-davis-murtha.holbrook.flac2448**: source not stated; 24 songs; 155 min [3]
- **gd85-06-27.sbd.miller.27863.sbeok.flacf**: soundboard; 23 songs; 161 min; rated 4.25/5 by 28 [5]
- **gd85-06-27.oade-schoeps.sacks.25000.sbeok.flacf**: source not stated; 22 songs; 157 min; rated 2.5/5 by 6 [11]. Said about its sound: Oade Schoeps source has fuller sound and a you-are-there feel; if flat, adjust the equalizer; Baby Blue is cut off at about the same spot on both the FOB and Oade sources [29][30]
- **gd85-06-27.aud.connor.7006.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 23 songs; 146 min; rated 4/5 by 6 [16]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls this audience tape respectable with its moments, unlike hissy, low-fidelity 1985 soundboards; Reviewer finds widely circulated Oade PCM tapes from 1985 muffled and flat, with weak clean bass [28]

## Around the show

- Band members joked about a man hanging from a structure at the venue [32]
- Attendee, just out of high school, bought lawn seats on show day and brought fifteen friends [36]
- Attendee says he was the man hanging off the balcony while flirting with two girls [36]
- Reviewer thinks Phil called the balcony man Butch, not Bush [37]
- Attendee drove up from Long Island with three others, selling early tie-dye tees to fund the trip [39]
- Group spent two hours building a makeshift Hefty-bag tent on a Duster's trunk before a state trooper arrived [39]
- Bobby tells someone the management asked them not to hang off there [3]
- Reviewer says it was not the best show of the tour but full of energy [36]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1985-06-27.sbd.gmb.79382.flac16**: taped by DAT kindly provided for transfer by M.Townshend; transferred by C.Ladner; source: SBD > MC > DAT(48KHz) [1]. Also: Soundboard source; first 11 seconds of disc one track one are spliced from an earlier circulating soundboard [1]
- **gd1985-06-27.sbd.gmb.79558.flac24**: taped by DAT kindly provided for transfer by M.Townshend; transferred by Chris Ladner; source: SBD > MC > DAT(48KHz) [2]. Also: 24-bit version upsampled to 24/96 with Waves IDR; first 11 seconds spliced from earlier circulating soundboard [2]
- **gd1985-06-27.152627.akgc422-davis-murtha.holbrook.flac2448**: taped by Executive Crew; Kenny Davis, Sean Murtha, Tom Pinney; transferred by Kyle Holbrook; source: Microphones: AKG C422|AKG S42 XY s1:60º cardioid s2: 90º cardioid [-10dB pad on] Recorder: Sony TC-D5M [mic master] Location: Lawn ~175' from stage DFC This… [3]. Also: Tape was paused to save tape and stopped and restarted on the master; right channel loses 8 seconds [3]
- **gd85-06-27.sbd.miller.27863.sbeok.flacf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: flac16 SBD> Master Cassette> PCM> Dat (unconfirmed- could be SBD> VHS> Cass> Dat> CD); [5].
